fact: Gyrgum offers an optional NDA to Werz Saltbaron to keep their dealings secret.
source_quote: Gyrgum offered an optional NDA — which Werz heard as a "Non-Demonic Agreement"
subject: NDA negotiation start

fact: The ghost says "boo" to intimidate Werz Saltbaron into signing the NDA.
source_quote: the ghost said "boo."
subject: ghost intimidation

fact: Werz Saltbaron states he will gladly sign the contract because it will be enforced by a fearsome ghost.
source_quote: Werz: "I will gladly sign such a contract, especially if it will be enforced by a fearsome ghost like this."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Gyrgum drafts a formal contract with his fancy pen.
source_quote: Gyrgum drafts a formal contract with his fancy pen
subject: contract drafting

fact: Daz proposes the NDA price starts at 1,250 gold pieces but offers it for 1,000.
source_quote: normally our NDA comes for the low, low price of 1,250 gold. But today… we'd be willing to go down to a flat thousand gold pieces.
subject: Daz price proposal

fact: Thorin states he almost blurted out how much money Daz has, but failed his save.
source_quote: Thorin: "I almost blurted out how much money you got, but I missed the save."
subject: Thorin

fact: The party raises the NDA price from 1,000 to 1,100 gold pieces after Werz haggles.
source_quote: The party raises the price from 1,000 to 1,100 gold pieces after he questions their initial offer.
subject: price increase

fact: Werz Saltbaron calls the 1,000 gold piece price a form of highway robbery.
source_quote: Werz attempts to haggle, "A thousand gold pieces. This is a form of highway robbery."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Werz Saltbaron backpedals, stating he thought it would be insulting to accept the first offer.
source_quote: Werz backpedals: "I thought it would be insulting for me to accept your first offer."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Werz Saltbaron pays the 1,100 gold piece fee, concluding the NDA.
source_quote: Werz pays the 1,100 gold piece fee and the NDA is concluded.
subject: NDA concluded

fact: Werz Saltbaron provides information about Clan Ironhead.
source_quote: Werz provides information about various Duergar clans, including Clan Ironhead
subject: Clan Ironhead

fact: Clan Thrazgad is a clan of armorsmiths who complain their stores have been raided recently.
source_quote: Clan Thrazgad is another clan of armorsmiths who complain their stores have been raided recently.
subject: Clan Thrazgad

fact: Clan Xundom will back the Deepking if there is a contest for power.
source_quote: Clan Xundom will back the Deepking if there's any contest for power.
subject: Clan Xundom

fact: The party presses Werz Saltbaron on the fact that only the NDA's price was negotiated, not the job itself.
source_quote: The party presses Werz on the fact that only the NDA's price was negotiated, never the job itself.
subject: job clarification

fact: Werz Saltbaron offers his services to Blingdenstone in exchange for the party removing the assassins targeting him.
source_quote: Werz says the deal is that they remove the assassins and he offers his services to Blingdenstone.
subject: assassin deal

fact: Werz Saltbaron protests that the party has bled him dry and he has to maintain his profit margins.
source_quote: He protests, "You've bled me dry," and says he has to maintain his profit margins.
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Daz states they can refund the money and expose Werz Saltbaron's activities.
source_quote: Daz: "Well, we can refund the money and let everybody know what you're up to."
subject: Daz

fact: Werz Saltbaron gives the party five special gems as a symbol of good faith.
source_quote: Werz gives the party five special gems as a symbol of good faith
subject: special gems

fact: The special gems are valued at 100 gold pieces each.
source_quote: Daz asks their value, and it is put at 100 GP each.
subject: special gems

fact: Werz Saltbaron suggests the party talk to their Gnomish friends about why the gems are special.
source_quote: Werz: "before you sell these gems, I suggest you talk to your Gnomish friends and ask them why these are special."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Gyrgum states he is hoping the gems are not cursed.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "I'm hoping they're not cursed."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The party agrees to deal with the assassins targeting Werz Saltbaron in exchange for his influence and trade favors in Blingdenstone.
source_quote: The party agrees to deal with the assassins targeting Werz in exchange for his influence and trade favors in Blingdenstone.
subject: party agreement
